hero.summary_en: South African programme information is split between 4Racing and Race Coast.
hero.summary_ja: 南アフリカの番組情報は4RacingとRace Coastに分かれています。

paragraphs_en: Race Coast now provides the reviewed KZN & Western Cape fixture mother set. 4Racing remains a separate subsystem and is not yet production-routed because a reusable precise-date mother set has not been established.
paragraphs_ja: Race CoastはKZN・Western Capeのレビュー済み開催母表を提供しています。4Racingは別体系で、再利用可能な正確な開催日母表が未確立のため、まだproduction routingしていません。

racing_types.name_ja: サラブレッド平地競走
racing_types.summary_en: The reviewed timetable routes are operator-specific.
racing_types.summary_ja: レビュー済み時刻表導線はoperator別です。

seasonality.summary_en: Use Race Coast fixtures for its four current venues; 4Racing requires separate confirmation.
seasonality.summary_ja: Race Coastの4会場は公式fixturesを使用し、4Racingは別途確認が必要です。

schedule.summary_en: Race Coast production currently confirms meeting date and venue only; post times are not inferred.
schedule.summary_ja: 現在のRace Coast productionは開催日と会場のみを確認し、発走時刻は推測しません。

surfaces.summary_en: Surface claims are not normalized across operators in this batch.
surfaces.summary_ja: このbatchではoperator間の馬場情報を共通化しません。

systems.summary_en: 4Racing remains a separate reviewed operator system; current precise-date mother-set routing is pending.
systems.summary_ja: 4Racingは別個のoperator体系として維持し、正確な開催日母表のproduction routingは保留中です。

systems.summary_en: Race Coast provides the current KZN & Western Cape fixture calendar.
systems.summary_ja: Race CoastがKZN・Western Capeの現行開催日程を提供します。

calendar_guidance_en: Race Coast is production-routed at C for its KZN & Western Cape venues. Treat 4Racing as a separate unrouted subsystem until a precise-date official mother set is established.
calendar_guidance_ja: Race CoastはKZN・Western Capeの会場をCでproduction routingしています。4Racingは正確な公式開催日母表が確立するまで別の未routing体系として扱います。
coverage_note_en: Current production support is partial South Africa coverage: Race Coast only, rank C. 4Racing is not claimed.
coverage_note_ja: 現在のproduction対応は南アフリカの一部のみで、Race CoastをCで対応します。4Racing対応済みとはみなしません。

triggers_ja: 4Racingの正確な開催日母表が見つかった時
